'''Hueches''' were extinct predators from [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]], and the only natural predators of the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]]. If confronted by a hueche, or even a resemblance of one, a normally fierce Colicoid would instinctively curl itself into a ball and roll away. They were feline creatures with two rows of razor sharp teeth.
